about_the_game:
​Demo version does not support controller.

Scene in demo version is bright, but the rest two chapters are dark, including uncomfortable content​.

'Paid By Blood' is a visual novel with a top-down and fixed camera perspective, supplemented by a few battles. You will play as Scout No. 3, venturing deep into dangerous zone to uncover the path leading to Ground Zero.

The total text volume of the game is approximately 50,000 Chinese characters (excluding punctuation marks).

Most texts can be freely chosen for reading or not. Your reading progress and choices will not affect the ending.

short_description: 'Paid By Blood' is a linear 3D visual novel with a top-down and fixed camera perspective, decorated by a few battles. Play as Scout No.3, venturing deep into dangerous zone to find the path leading to Ground Zero. Search and find everything interactable for clues.
